what: a Fomorian: one of the misshapen one-eyed sea-giants of Irish myth, kin of Balor of the Evil Eye, a massive, lopsided, hunched giant come up out of the sea, painted seriously. He is a cyclops with one giant eye in the centre of his face: he has no ordinary eyes, there is only smooth wet skin where a man's two eyes would be, and in the middle of his forehead is one single huge bulging eyeball as wide as half his face, glowing a baleful sickly yellow with one black slit pupil, under one heavy brow. His skin is an unnatural cold grey-green, the colour of a stormy sea, rough and wet, with clusters of pale barnacles on his shoulders and forearms. His head is lumpy and hairless on top, with a heavy jutting jaw, broken tusk-like lower teeth, and long ropes of dark brown seaweed hanging from his chin and the back of his head in place of hair. One shoulder is much higher than the other and one arm is thicker than the other.
colours: cold grey-green wet skin, pale grey-white barnacles, dark brown seaweed hair and beard, one big glowing sickly yellow eye, a dark grey sealskin kilt, a dull tan fishing net, a pale grey driftwood club.
wears: He wears a long dark grey sealskin kilt with a rope belt, and a mantle made of an old tan fishing net knotted over one shoulder and across his chest, hung with a few big shells.
holds: He holds exactly one club in his right hand: one straight length of pale grey driftwood, narrow at the grip, swelling to a knobbly end, nothing fixed to it. His left hand is an open empty hand with thick fingers.
pose: On two legs, he lurches forward to the left, hunched, the driftwood club held out low to the right of his body in his right hand, well clear of his head, his left hand reaching out ahead, his head thrust forward so the one enormous glowing eye in the middle of his forehead glares straight at the viewer, mouth open in a roar.
must_show: a lopsided hunched giant with grey-green sea-wet skin
exactly one eye: one enormous glowing sickly yellow eyeball in the centre of the forehead, and no other eyes
seaweed hair and barnacles
one driftwood club, the other hand empty
sealskin kilt and net mantle

what: Cacus: the fire-breathing giant of Virgil, son of the smith-god Vulcan, a cattle thief who lives in a smoking cave, painted seriously as a mighty and terrible lord of his kind. He is not a man of flesh: his whole body is the colour of a burnt-out forge, dark charcoal-grey and soot-black like cooled iron slag, rough, pitted and cracked like a cinder, on his face, neck, arms, hands, legs and feet alike, and thin lines of ember-orange fire glow in the cracks on his forearms, fists and face. He is an immense, hunched, barrel-bodied giant with a short thick neck, a head sunk between huge shoulders and arms thicker than his legs. He has a brutal half-beast face with a heavy brow, a flat broad nose, pointed ears, two small burning orange eyes and a wide mouth of blunt pale tusks, and a huge shaggy mane of coarse black hair and a tangled black beard. One short jet of orange and yellow flame shoots straight out of his open mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than his own head.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and soot-black cinder skin on every part of him, with thin ember-orange glowing cracks, shaggy black hair and beard, burning orange eyes, pale tusks, an orange and yellow flame at the mouth, a dark brown shaggy ox-hide tunic, a broad dark bronze belt, three pale bone-white cattle skulls with horns, dark bronze arm rings.
wears: He wears a long tunic of dark brown shaggy ox-hide with a hole for his head, which covers both his shoulders, his whole chest and his belly and hangs to his knees, girt with a broad dark bronze belt from which hang three big pale horned cattle skulls; heavy dark bronze rings on both upper arms; and a necklace of big curved cattle horns lying on the hide. His own head is bare.
holds: His hands are empty: two enormous clenched fists, cracked and glowing faintly at the knuckles. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, seen a little from the side, he stamps forward to the left in a wide heavy stride, body leaning in, both great fists raised above his shoulders to slam down, his head thrust forward and his mouth wide open with the one short jet of flame shooting out of it to the left.
must_show: an immense hunched giant whose skin is dark charcoal-grey cinder with glowing ember cracks, on the face, arms and legs alike
one short jet of fire shooting from his mouth, joined to it
shaggy black hair and beard
a shaggy brown ox-hide tunic covering the shoulders, chest and belly, and a belt hung with horned cattle skulls
empty fists raised, no weapon
far more imposing and ornate than the Fomorian
must_not_show: long stream of fire running off the picture

what: a bullywug: a frog-man of the flooded caves, painted seriously like a plate in a natural history book. It has the head of a real bullfrog set on a squat man-sized body: a broad flat head with a very wide mouth, two round bulging gold-brown eyes with black bar pupils set high on the head, and a pale swollen throat sac. Its body is short and squat with a round belly, thin arms, long folded frog's hind legs with big webbed feet, and webbed hands. Its skin is wet and warty, dull dark olive-green mottled with black-brown blotches on the back and arms, and dirty pale yellow-cream on the throat and belly.
colours: dull dark olive-green skin with black-brown blotches, a dirty pale yellow-cream throat and belly, gold-brown eyes, a brown reed kilt, a dark wooden spear with a grey flint head.
wears: It wears only a short kilt of brown woven reeds and a cord round its neck with one small bone on it; no armour.
holds: It holds exactly one thick wooden spear with a broad grey flint head in both webbed hands, the shaft held slanting across its body with the point at the upper left, clear of its head.
pose: On two legs, it squats low with both long hind legs deeply folded and both webbed feet flat, about to leap to the left, body leaning forward, the spear thrust out ahead, its wide mouth open and its throat sac swollen in a croak.
must_show: a real frog's head on a squat body, wide mouth, bulging eyes high on the head
dull olive-green warty skin with a pale belly
long folded frog's hind legs and webbed feet
one spear in both hands
reed kilt only, the plainest of the two

what: a kuo-toa: a fish-man of the sunless seas. It has the head of a fish set on a man's shoulders: the head of a big deep-sea fish with a blunt snout, a wide downturned mouth full of small needle teeth, gill slits at the sides of the neck, a spiny fin running from the top of the head down the back, and two huge round bulging eyes with no eyelids, pale yellow with black pupils. Its body is a lean, stooped man's body covered all over in big wet fish scales, pale silver-grey on the chest, belly and limbs and dark slate-grey down the back and the top of the head, with webbed clawed hands and broad webbed feet.
colours: pale silver-grey scales on the front, dark slate-grey on the back and head, pale yellow eyes, a dark brown shield smeared with glistening amber glue, a pale bone spear point, driftwood and bone charms of pale grey and white, a dark brown eel-skin kilt.
wears: It wears a dark brown eel-skin kilt and a harness of cord across its chest hung with a few big charms of pale driftwood and bone.
holds: It holds exactly one thick spear with a broad barbed pale bone point in its right hand, raised to stab, and exactly one round shield on its left arm: a dark brown shield of hide whose face is smeared thickly with glistening amber-coloured glue.
pose: On two legs, it advances to the left stooped behind the round shield held out in front of its body, the spear raised overhand in its right hand with the point aimed forward and down to the left, its fish mouth gaping.
must_show: a fish's head on a man's shoulders, huge round lidless eyes
silver-grey scales all over, a spiny fin down the head and back
one spear and one round shield smeared with amber glue
bone and driftwood charms
better armed than the bullywug

what: an ettercap: a hunched spider-keeper, a creature half man and half spider, painted seriously. It has a lean, stooped, pot-bellied body on two thin bowed legs, with very long thin arms that end in hands of two long black hooked claws. Its head is a spider's head set on its shoulders with no neck: a bristly rounded head with a cluster of six small round black shining eyes on the front and, where a mouth would be, two big thick curved black fangs pointing downward, with pale yellow venom on the tips. Its skin is a leathery dull ash-grey hide, with coarse charcoal-black bristles on the head, shoulders, back and forearms, and a paler bone-grey belly. A short stubby pointed bulge at the base of its spine shows a tuft of white silk.
colours: dull ash-grey leathery hide, charcoal-black bristles, a pale bone-grey belly, black shining eyes, black fangs and claws, thick white web silk, a dirty grey-white kilt of woven silk.
wears: It wears a ragged kilt of its own dirty grey-white woven web silk tied at the waist, and a loop of thick white silk rope across its chest.
holds: It holds exactly one thick white rope of web silk, as thick as its wrist, stretched taut between its two clawed hands like a snare, held out in front of its chest.
pose: On two legs, it creeps forward to the left in a deep stoop with its knees bent and its head low, both long arms held out ahead pulling the thick white silk rope taut between its claws, its two fangs spread apart.
must_show: a hunched two-legged creature with a spider's head: a cluster of black eyes and two big downward fangs
ash-grey hide with black bristles
long arms ending in two hooked claws
a thick white rope of web silk stretched between its hands
no weapon
must_not_show: a spider's round abdomen in place of legs

what: a Kusarikku: the Bull-Man of ancient Mesopotamia, as carved on Assyrian gateways, painted seriously. Above the waist he is a powerful man, with a man's chest, arms and hands and the head of a human man: a stern face with a strong nose, lips and chin, dark eyes, and a long, square-cut black beard in tight rows of curls, and long curled black hair to his shoulders. From the sides of his human head grow two short thick bull's horns curving forward, and he has a bull's ears. Below the waist he has the hindquarters of a bull standing upright: two heavy bull's hind legs covered in short dark brown hair, bent backward at the hock, ending in big black cloven hooves, and a long bull's tail with a black tuft.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin on the face and hands, a black curled beard and hair, pale ivory horns, dark brown bull's hair on the legs, black hooves, a dull dark red fringed wool tunic, a broad dark bronze belt, dark bronze wrist bands.
wears: He wears a short-sleeved tunic of dull dark red wool with a long tasselled fringe, covering his whole chest and belly down to the hips, a broad dark bronze belt, and dark bronze bands on both wrists. He wears no helmet.
holds: His hands are empty: two clenched fists. He holds nothing.
pose: Seen a little from the side, standing upright on his two bull's legs, he charges to the left with his body pitched forward and his bearded head lowered so the two horns aim ahead, one hoofed leg lifted high to stamp, both fists drawn back at his sides, his tail lashing behind.
must_show: a human man's bearded face, not a bull's face
a long square black curled beard
two bull's horns on the human head
bull's hind legs with cloven hooves and a tail, standing upright on two legs
a red fringed tunic covering the chest
empty fists

what: a titanspawn: something of the imprisoned Titans leaked up out of Tartarus, a heap of broken bedrock piled into the rough shape of a giant, painted seriously, heavy and ancient. It is made only of separate boulders and jagged slabs of dark basalt with slanting broken faces, none of them square, and there is a wide gap between each rock and the next, and a dull violet light shines out of every gap, so that the whole figure looks like dark rocks held together by violet light. Its body is one huge cracked boulder. Its head is one small wedge-shaped rock set straight on top of the body, with no face: only one jagged crack across it filled with violet light. Each arm is three boulders, one after the other, thicker than its legs, ending in a fist that is a single great rock. Its legs are short pillars of stacked slabs. Round each wrist is a broad broken band of old tarnished brown bronze, the remains of a shackle. All the rock is dark charcoal-grey basalt with rough, pitted, sharp-edged surfaces.
colours: dark charcoal-grey basalt rock with paler ash-grey broken edges and black seams, a dull violet glow in the chest seams and the two eyes, two broad wrist bands of tarnished brown bronze.
wears: It wears nothing but the two broken bronze shackle bands, one on each wrist.
holds: Its hands are empty: two great fists of rock. It holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it lumbers forward to the left, hunched, with its right fist of rock drawn far back and up to strike and its left arm swung out ahead for balance, leaning into the step.
must_show: a giant made of separate jagged dark basalt boulders with gaps between them
arms of big boulders, thicker than the legs, fists of rock
dull violet light shining in the gaps between the rocks; a faceless rock head with one glowing crack
a broken bronze shackle band on each wrist
no weapon

what: a gas spore: a floating fungus, one big round puffball swollen tight with gas, painted seriously like a plate in a book of fungi. It is a single leathery sphere, wrinkled and pitted like an old puffball mushroom, dull grey-brown mottled with dirty ochre patches and darker brown cracks. In the middle of its front is one large round pale blister, a third as wide as the sphere, flat and milky grey-white like a blind cataract, with a darker ring round its rim and nothing inside it. From the top of the sphere sprout five short, thick, limp fungus stalks, each ending in a small round knob, drooping in different directions. A short ragged beard of thick pale root-threads hangs from its underside, joined to it. It is only a fungus.
colours: dull grey-brown leathery skin with dirty ochre patches and dark brown cracks, one milky grey-white blister on the front, pale tan stalks and root-threads.
wears: It is a fungus and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It floats in empty air, tilted a little to the left, the pale blister on its front turned toward the viewer, the five short stalks on top drooping and the root-threads trailing below it.
must_show: one round leathery puffball, dull grey-brown and ochre, wrinkled
one big pale milky blister on the front with no pupil
short limp fungus stalks with knobs on top
short root-threads hanging underneath, joined to it
plainly a fungus, the smallest and simplest plant here
must_not_show: a living eyeball with an iris and pupil

what: a thorn slinger: a squat dungeon plant that shoots its thorns, painted seriously like a botanical plate. It has no trunk and no stem under it: it is one low heap, twice as wide as it is tall, of five big round seed pods piled close together and touching, three in a row at the bottom and two on top, sitting directly on a small flat knot of pale roots. Each pod is a swollen dull tan-brown ball covered all over in long thick dark brown spines that stick straight out in every direction, so that the whole heap bristles. Short, thick, crooked, pale bone-grey thorny twigs poke out sideways between the pods, with a few small, narrow, dull olive-grey leaves. The pod at the upper left has split wide open like a mouth, and the inside of it is packed with a tight bundle of long dark thorns all pointing out to the left. It is only a plant.
colours: pale bone-grey woody stems, a few small dull olive-grey leaves, dull tan-brown round seed pods, long dark brown thorns and spines.
wears: It is a plant and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The low heap of spiny pods sits tilted a little to the left, the split pod at the upper left tipped forward and gaping open with its packed thorns aimed to the left, the short thorny twigs bristling out to both sides.
must_show: a low squat heap of big round spiny seed pods, wider than tall, with no trunk under it
every pod covered all over in long dark spines
one pod split open showing thorns packed inside
short pale thorny twigs and a few small leaves between the pods
no face: only a plant
must_not_show: loose thorns flying in the air

what: a violet fungus: a big cave mushroom that feeds on the dead, painted seriously like a plate in a book of fungi. It is one tall thick mushroom with a broad, drooping, uneven cap, dull dusky violet, the dark dirty colour of a bruise, blotched with grey and spotted with a few pale warts, and dark ragged gills under the cap. Its stalk is thick, pale grey-lilac, fibrous and stained darker toward the base, which swells into a bulb with a few short pale roots. From the stalk just under the cap grow four long, thick, ropy fungus branches, each as thick as the stalk is at half its width, dull violet-grey and tapering to a blunt tip: one reaches up and to the left, one stretches straight out to the left, one curls up and to the right, and one hangs out to the lower right. It is only a fungus.
colours: a dull dusky violet cap with grey blotches and pale grey warts, dark purple-brown gills, a pale grey-lilac stalk, dull violet-grey ropy branches, pale tan roots.
wears: It is a fungus and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The mushroom leans to the left, its cap tipped that way, with its four ropy branches spread out and feeling through the air, the two on the left stretched far out as if reaching for something.
must_show: one tall mushroom with a broad dull violet cap
a thick pale stalk
four thick ropy branches growing from under the cap, spread in different directions
dull, dirty, bruise-coloured, not bright
no face: only a fungus

what: a shambling mound: a walking heap of rotting swamp plants, painted seriously, heavy and wet. It is a great hunched mound of sodden reeds, tangled creeper stems and hanging bog moss, as wide as it is tall, with no head and no neck: its top is one rounded hump of piled rotting reeds, and deep in the front of the hump, set directly in the tangle, are two small dull yellow glowing eyes. Two very thick arms made of twisted creeper stems, each as thick as a tree trunk, hang from the sides of the mound and end in shapeless clumps of roots and vines with no fingers. It walks on two short, thick stumps of matted roots. Long strands of wet moss and weed hang from its arms and body, and a few broad dead leaves and a broken bulrush stick out of its back.
colours: dark rotten olive-green and black-green wet plants, dark peat-brown creeper stems and roots, dull yellow-brown dead reeds, two small dull yellow eyes.
wears: It is a heap of plants and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its two arms end in empty clumps of roots and vines.
pose: On its two short root stumps, it lumbers forward to the left, leaning over, its right arm of twisted creepers raised high to slam down and its left arm reaching out low ahead to gather something in, moss swinging.
must_show: a great hunched heap of rotting reeds, creeper and moss, as wide as tall
no head: a rounded hump with two small dull yellow eyes sunk in it
two very thick arms of twisted creeper ending in clumps of roots
dark, wet, rotten green and peat-brown
the largest and most dangerous plant here

what: a changeling: a fairy creature left in a human cradle and now grown up, caught with its borrowed human face slipping off, painted seriously and eerily. It is not a human being and its skin is no living person's colour: its skin is pale grey-green like lichen on a dead branch, dry and finely cracked, on the face, ears, neck and hands alike. It is a thin, narrow-shouldered, stooping figure of a grown adult's height with long thin arms. Its true head is bare and plain to see: a hairless, narrow, wizened, grey-green face with a pointed chin, a long thin nose, very long pointed ears that stick out sideways, a small mouth of little sharp teeth, and two very large slanted eyes that are solid shining black from edge to edge, with no white and no iris. Its long thin hands are the same grey-green. In its right hand, lifted just clear of its own face, it holds the borrowed face: a smooth, pale, calm human face like a mask of pale wax, with closed eyes and a gentle smile.
colours: pale grey-green lichen-coloured skin on the face, ears and hands, solid black eyes, a pale wax-cream human mask, a long dull dark moss-green villager's wool coat, a dark brown shoulder cape, dark brown trousers and worn leather shoes.
wears: It is fully dressed in stolen villager's clothes that hang loose on it: a long dull moss-green wool coat buttoned to the neck, a short dark brown shoulder cape, dark brown trousers and worn leather shoes. Its head is bare, with no hood.
holds: It holds exactly one mask in its right hand, raised beside its head: the smooth pale wax-cream human face it wears as a disguise, held by the edge. Its left hand is empty, reaching forward with long thin fingers spread.
pose: On two legs, it steps forward to the left in a stoop, its head tilted and turned to the viewer with its true grey-green face fully uncovered, the pale human mask held up in its right hand just beside its cheek as if this instant pulled away, its left hand reaching out ahead.
must_show: a thin stooping figure in loose villager's clothes, fully clothed
its true face uncovered: pale grey-green skin, wizened, long pointed ears, large solid black eyes
a pale smooth human face-mask held in one hand beside its head
the other hand empty, reaching
two faces in the picture: the true one and the borrowed one
must_not_show: an ordinary living human face on the head
an old man with human eyes

what: a fetch: the Irish death-omen, an undead double that has not yet finished copying the person it has come for, painted seriously and eerily. It is the figure of a tall, thin adult traveller, but it has no face. Its head is a smooth, hairless, featureless, chalk-white egg, like the blank head of a tailor's dummy: there are no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose and no ears on it, only smooth blank white skin, and the single feature on the whole head is one wide, thin, dark, curved line low down on it, a closed smiling mouth. Its neck and its long-fingered hands are the same cold chalk-white with grey shadows, dead, never a living colour. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall thin adult: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold chalk-white dead skin with grey shadows, a long plain ash-grey traveller's cloak, a charcoal-grey tunic and trousers, black boots, a round hand-mirror with a dark iron frame and a bright silver-white glass.
wears: It is fully dressed as a traveller, all in greys as if the colour had been drained out: a long plain ash-grey cloak fastened at the throat, a charcoal-grey belted tunic covering the body to the knees, charcoal trousers and black boots. Its head is bare, with no hood.
holds: It holds exactly one round hand-mirror in its left hand, raised beside its head with the bright silver-white glass turned to the viewer: a round mirror as big as its face in a thick dark iron frame with a short thick handle. Its right hand is empty, stretched out ahead with the long white fingers spread to touch.
pose: On two legs, it walks straight toward the viewer and a little to the left in a long smooth step, weight on its front foot, its right arm stretched out ahead to touch, the round mirror held up beside its blank smiling head in its left hand, the cloak swinging behind.
must_show: a tall thin figure in grey traveller's clothes, fully clothed
chalk-white dead skin
a smooth blank egg-like white head with no eyes and no nose, only a wide smiling mouth line
one round hand-mirror held up beside the head
the other hand empty, reaching to touch

what: a Puca: the shape-changing night spirit of Irish country lore, caught between two of its shapes, the black horse and the black goat, painted seriously. It is a real animal on four legs, seen from the side: a lean, sleek, wild black horse with a long neck and a long tangled mane and tail, but from its brow sweep two long ridged goat's horns curving back over its neck, a long goat's beard hangs from its chin, and its four legs end in black cloven goat's hooves. Its coat is glossy coal-black, and every curve of its neck, shoulder, back and haunch carries a long streak of pale steel-grey highlight so that the body reads as round and solid. Its eyes burn like coals, bright orange with a yellow centre, and its mouth is open showing big teeth.
colours: glossy coal-black coat with pale steel-grey highlights, a ragged black mane and tail, pale grey-tan ridged horns, bright orange coal-like eyes, ivory teeth, black hooves.
wears: It is a wild creature and wears nothing: no saddle, no bridle, no harness.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it tears along at a wild gallop, its front legs lifted and reaching forward and its hind legs driving off the ground, neck arched and head tossed toward the viewer with the eyes blazing and the mouth open, mane and tail flying.
must_show: a sleek black horse on four legs, seen from the side, galloping
two long backswept goat's horns and a goat's beard on the horse's head
eyes burning orange like coals
grey highlights so the black body reads as solid, not a flat black shape
no saddle or bridle
must_not_show: flames on the mane or hooves

what: an Each Uisce: the man-eating water horse of the Highland sea lochs, painted seriously, sleek and patient and wrong. It is a real animal on four legs, seen from the side: a tall, fine, powerful horse whose coat is wet and slick like a seal's, dark sea-teal shading to a pale grey-green belly, streaming with water. Its mane and tail are not hair: they are long, heavy, dripping ribbons of dark green-brown kelp. A ragged fish's fin runs down the back of each leg above the hoof, and a low spiny fin stands along the crest of its neck under the kelp. Its head is a horse's head with eyes that are blank, round and pale white with no pupil, and its mouth is open showing rows of sharp pointed predator's teeth instead of a horse's flat teeth.
colours: wet dark sea-teal coat, a pale grey-green belly, a mane and tail of dark green-brown kelp, dark teal fins, blank white eyes, sharp white teeth, black hooves.
wears: It is a wild creature and wears nothing: no saddle, no bridle.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it rears a little with its front hooves lifted off the ground to trample and its hind legs planted, neck arched, head thrust forward and down to the left with the jaws open showing the sharp teeth, the kelp mane and tail swinging heavily.
must_show: a tall horse on four legs, seen from the side, wet and slick
a dark sea-teal coat, unlike the black Puca
a mane and tail of dripping kelp, not hair
sharp pointed teeth in an open mouth and blank white eyes
fins on the legs or neck
no saddle or bridle
must_not_show: fish tail instead of hind legs

what: a weretiger: the harimau jadian of Malay lore, a man of the Sumatran highlands caught in the middle of changing into a tiger, painted seriously. He stands on two legs, lean and long-limbed, in a man's clothes. His head is a real tiger's head with a broad striped face, white cheek ruffs, small round ears, amber eyes and bared white fangs, and it still wears a man's folded cloth head-wrap. His hands and forearms, showing from his sleeves, are a tiger's: thick, covered in orange fur with black stripes, ending in broad paws with long curved ivory claws. His bare feet are striped tiger's paws, and a long striped tiger's tail swings behind him. Every part of his body not covered by cloth is covered in striped fur; no bare human skin shows anywhere.
colours: deep orange fur with bold black stripes, white fur on the cheeks, muzzle and throat, amber eyes, ivory claws and fangs, a dark maroon long-sleeved tunic, a knee-length wrap skirt of dull brown-gold woven cloth with a dark check, a dark maroon head-wrap, a black sash.
wears: He is fully dressed as a Malay highland man: a dark maroon long-sleeved tunic that covers his whole chest and belly, closed to the neck, a black sash at the waist, a knee-length wrap skirt of dull brown-gold checked cloth over dark trousers, and a folded dark maroon cloth head-wrap between his tiger's ears. The tunic is split at one shoulder seam.
holds: His hands are empty: two tiger's paws with the claws out. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, he stalks to the left in a low crouch, knees bent, body leaning far forward and head low, one clawed paw reaching out ahead and the other drawn back by his hip, jaws open in a snarl, his long tail curling up behind.
must_show: a tiger's head: orange fur, black stripes, white cheeks
upright on two legs in a man's clothes: a maroon tunic covering the chest and a wrap skirt
a cloth head-wrap still on the tiger's head
striped furred paws with claws, and a long striped tail
empty hands, stalking pose

what: a werebear: a Norse warrior of the sagas cursed into a bear's shape, caught in the change, painted seriously. He stands on two legs, enormous, broad and heavy, far bulkier than a man, with a bear's sloping shoulders and thick short neck, still in a warrior's clothes that are splitting on him. His head is a real brown bear's head, with a long pale-brown muzzle, a black nose, small round ears, small dark eyes and an open mouth of big white teeth. His forearms and hands, showing from his torn sleeves, are a bear's: thick, covered in shaggy dark brown fur, ending in broad paws with long black claws. His feet are a bear's furred paws. Every part of him not covered by cloth is covered in shaggy dark brown fur; no bare human skin shows anywhere.
colours: shaggy dark brown fur, a paler tan-brown muzzle, a black nose and black claws, white teeth, a dull dark red wool tunic, a broad black leather belt with a dull iron buckle, dark grey wool trousers, one twisted dull silver arm ring.
wears: He is fully dressed as a Norse warrior: a knee-length dull dark red wool tunic that covers his whole chest and belly, split at both shoulder seams and torn at the sleeves by the bulk inside it, a broad black leather belt with an iron buckle, dark grey wool trousers torn at the knee, and one thick twisted silver ring on his upper arm over the sleeve. His bear's head is bare.
holds: His hands are empty: two great bear's paws with the claws spread. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, he rears up tall and lunges to the left with his weight on his front foot, both thick arms spread wide and curving forward to seize in a crushing hug, claws spread, his head thrust forward and turned a little to the viewer, roaring.
must_show: a brown bear's head on an enormous upright body
a Norse warrior's red tunic covering the chest, splitting at the seams, with belt and trousers
shaggy brown furred arms ending in paws with long black claws
far heavier and broader than the weretiger
empty paws, arms spread to hug
must_not_show: an ordinary bear on four legs with no clothes

what: an allip: what is left of a mind that broke before its body died, painted seriously and grimly with depth and light. It is one tall, thin twist of darkness hanging in the air, like a torn shroud of soot-black smoke wrung into a tight spiral, wide and ragged at the top and winding down to a single thin point at the bottom, with nothing inside it. It is coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges of the spiral, with one thin line of sickly pale yellow light along its left edge. Near the top, sunk in the smoke, is one plain, solid, bone-white mask like an ancient theatre mask of grief, hairless and tilted to one side, with two hollow black eye holes and a black mouth hole hanging open and crooked as if muttering. Two long thin ropes of the black smoke rise beside the mask and end in two bone-white hands with spread fingers, pressed against the two sides of the mask.
colours: coal-black and dark slate-grey twisting smoke, one thin line of sickly pale yellow light on its left edge, one bone-white mask with black eye and mouth holes, two bone-white hands.
wears: It is nothing but a twist of smoke.
holds: It holds nothing; its two pale hands are pressed to the sides of its own pale mask.
pose: The spiral of smoke leans and drifts to the left through empty air, its top bowed forward, the white mask tilted and turned to the viewer with its mouth hanging open, the two white hands clutching the sides of the mask, the thin point of the spiral trailing down to the right.
must_show: one tall twist of black smoke wound in a spiral, tapering to a point at the bottom
one bone-white mask of grief with black eye holes and an open crooked mouth hole
two bone-white hands pressed to the sides of the mask
dark and folded, with depth, not a flat blob
must_not_show: a man's body made of smoke
flat black blob with dot eyes

what: a haunting presence: the dread left behind in a room where something terrible happened, a thing with no face and no voice, painted seriously with depth and soft light. It is one tall, empty, pale veil hanging in the air: a long sheet of thin, torn gauze, cold silver-grey and white like linen stiff with hoar frost, draped as if over someone standing who is not there, so that it rises to a rounded top, falls in long heavy folds and ends in a ragged, tattered hem. There is nothing inside it. High on the front, the veil sinks inward into one deep, tall, oval hollow of pitch-black darkness, with no features in it at all. The gauze is cold pale silver-grey, frost-white on the folds and dark slate-grey in the deep creases, with no warm colour anywhere, so that it reads as solid and round. A row of long thick white icicles hangs from the ragged hem, joined to it, and white frost rims the edge of the black hollow.
colours: cold pale silver-grey gauze, frost-white on the folds, dark slate-grey in the creases, one pitch-black oval hollow, white frost and white icicles.
wears: It is nothing but an empty veil.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The empty veil hangs upright in mid-air and leans forward to the left as if bending over the viewer, its rounded top bowed, the black hollow turned to the viewer, its long folds and tattered hem swept back to the right.
must_show: one tall empty veil of cold pale silver-grey gauze hanging in the air
one deep pitch-black oval hollow where a face would be, with nothing in it
white icicles hanging from the ragged hem
pale, cold and still: unlike the black allip
must_not_show: cartoon bedsheet ghost with two eye holes

what: a poltergeist: a noisy ghost that has no shape of its own, only a temper, seen as the whirl of household things it is flinging, painted seriously. It is one tight spinning knot of old furniture and crockery caught up in thick curling bands of pale grey ghost-wind, wholly inside the picture. There are six big things, each about a third of the picture wide, overlapping and touching so that no backdrop shows between them: in the middle a heavy old wooden chair tipped on its side with one leg broken; above it a black iron cooking pot upside down; at the upper left a three-legged wooden stool flying legs first; at the left a big dented pewter jug; below the chair a thick book flung open; at the right a broken wooden door plank with an iron hinge. Three or four broad, thick, curling bands of pale ash-grey wind wrap round and between the things like ribbons and bind them into one mass.
colours: dark brown and worn tan wood, black iron, dull grey pewter, a book with a dull dark red cover and cream pages, thick curling bands of pale ash-grey wind.
wears: It has no body and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; the flying things are the whole of it.
pose: The whole knot of things whirls and tilts to the left through empty air, the stool and the pewter jug flung out furthest toward the upper left, the bands of pale wind curling round them all in one spiral.
must_show: a tight whirl of flying household things: a wooden chair, an iron pot, a stool, a jug, a book
the things overlapping and touching in one mass, not scattered
thick curling bands of pale grey wind binding them
no figure at all
must_not_show: table standing upright on the ground
small loose pieces far from the mass

what: an ethereal filcher: the ghost of a thief that slips out of the spirit world to steal bright things, painted seriously. It is a tall, very thin, stooping, long-limbed figure made entirely of pale ghost-light, every part the same pale colour: pale bone-white with a faint cold grey-green tint, nearly white, on every part of it, body, hood and cloak alike, with dull grey-green only in the deep folds and hollows so that it reads as solid and round. It wears a thief's deep pointed hood, and inside the hood is a gaunt, hollow-cheeked face of the same pale light with two dark eye hollows. Its arms are very long and its hands have very long thin spidery fingers. It has the realistic proportions of a tall thin adult: a small head, long thin arms and legs, about eight heads tall. The one thing in the picture that is not ghost-coloured is the thing it has stolen: a big, solid, real golden goblet with a wide bowl and a thick stem, bright and heavy.
colours: pale bone-white ghost-light with a faint cold grey-green tint on every part of the figure, nearly white, with dull grey-green shadows in the deep folds, dark eye hollows, and one bright solid polished gold goblet.
wears: It wears a deep pointed thief's hood, a short ragged cloak, a close tunic and leggings, all of the same pale ghost-light as its body.
holds: It clutches exactly one big solid gold goblet against its chest with both long-fingered hands, the bright gold plain to see between the pale fingers. It holds nothing else.
pose: On two long thin legs, it runs to the left on tiptoe in a long sneaking stride, body stooped far forward, the gold goblet hugged to its chest in both hands, its hooded head turned back over its shoulder to look behind it toward the viewer, its ragged cloak streaming back to the right.
must_show: a tall thin hooded ghost made entirely of very pale, nearly white ghost-light with a faint grey-green tint
very long thin arms and fingers
one solid bright gold goblet clutched to its chest, the only warm colour
running away on tiptoe, looking back
no weapon

what: a specter: a ghost that has burned away everything it once was except its hunger, with no face, no name and no legs, painted seriously, cold and terrible. It is made entirely of cold pale light, pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, with a white-hot core down its middle and darker steel-blue in its hollows so that it reads as solid. Its upper part is a gaunt, narrow shape with a smooth, long, featureless head like a blank oval of white light, with no eyes, no nose and no mouth, bowed forward on a long neck; from its narrow sides two very long thin arms of the same light reach out, ending in huge hands with very long pointed fingers like icicles. Below the arms its body narrows into one long, ragged, tapering tail of the same pale light that curves away behind it, joined to it. Thick white frost and short icicles hang along the undersides of both arms.
colours: pale icy blue light, the blue of a winter sky, a white core, darker steel-blue hollows, white frost and icicles. No other colour anywhere.
wears: It wears nothing; it is only cold light.
holds: It holds nothing; both huge long-fingered hands are empty and reaching.
pose: It sweeps down and to the left through empty air, its blank head bowed forward, both long arms stretched far out ahead with the huge icicle-fingered hands spread wide to seize, its single long tapering tail of light curving up and away to the right.
must_show: a legless ghost made entirely of pale icy blue-white light
a smooth blank featureless head: no eyes, no mouth
two very long arms with huge long-fingered hands, reaching
one long tapering tail of light in place of legs, joined to the body
frost and icicles on the arms
the strongest and brightest of the spirits

what: a forsaken shell: a body whose soul a necromancer has torn out, a hollow corpse that still moves, painted seriously. It is the corpse of a lean medieval peasant, and it is dead, never the colour of living skin: its skin is cold chalk-white with grey shadows and thin black veins, on the head, neck, arms, hands and feet alike. Its head is hairless and thrown back, with a shrunken dead face: ears, a thin nose, lips dried back from the teeth, and two eyes that are blank and white with no pupils. In the very middle of its chest, where its tunic is torn open, is the place the soul was pulled from: one round black emptiness as big as its own head, like a hole into night, with a ring of cold cyan light burning round its rim and a few short black cracks running out from it across the chalk-white skin. He has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold chalk-white dead skin with grey shadows and thin black veins, blank white eyes, one round black hollow in the chest rimmed with cold cyan light, a ragged knee-length tunic of coarse undyed grey-brown homespun wool, a frayed rope belt, dirty grey rag leg-wrappings.
wears: It wears a medieval peasant's ragged knee-length tunic of coarse grey-brown homespun wool with long loose sleeves, torn open only in a round hole over the middle of the chest, tied with a frayed rope belt, and dirty grey rags wound round its shins. Its feet are bare.
holds: Its hands are empty; it holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it staggers forward to the left with its chest thrust out and its head thrown back, mouth gaping open in a wail, both arms flung out wide and loose to either side, flailing, one foot dragging.
must_show: a chalk-white corpse with blank white eyes, clothed in a ragged medieval peasant's tunic with a rope belt
one round black hollow in the middle of the chest, rimmed with cyan light
head thrown back, mouth open, arms flailing wide
empty hands
must_not_show: ribs or organs showing in the hole

what: a ghoul: the ghul of Arabian tales, a grave-robbing corpse-eater of the desert tombs, painted seriously. It is a hunched, wiry, long-armed creature that was once a man. It is dead flesh, never the colour of living skin: its hide is dull grey-green, the colour of old verdigris, leathery and tight over the bones, on the face, neck, arms, hands and feet alike. Its head juts forward on a long neck: a long heavy jaw pushed out like a muzzle with big crooked yellow fangs, a flat nose, long pointed ears, sunken eyes that glow dull yellow with no pupils, and a ridge of coarse black hair running from its scalp down the back of its neck. Its arms hang to its knees and end in big hands with long black claws, wet with a pale yellowish slime.
colours: dull grey-green leathery dead hide, a ridge of coarse black hair, dull yellow glowing eyes, yellow fangs, black claws with pale yellowish slime, a tattered robe of undyed pale sand-beige linen stained dark brown with grave earth, a ragged dull brown head-cloth.
wears: It wears the tattered remains of a desert traveller's long robe of pale sand-beige linen, covering its body from the shoulders to the knees, with the sleeves torn off at the elbows, and a ragged dull brown head-cloth hanging round its neck like a scarf.
holds: Its hands are empty: two big clawed hands dripping pale slime. It holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it lopes to the left in a deep crouch, knees bent and back hunched, head thrust low and forward with the long jaw open, one long clawed arm reaching far out ahead and the other hanging low so the claws nearly brush the ground.
must_show: a hunched long-armed creature with dull grey-green dead hide
a long jutting fanged jaw, pointed ears, dull yellow glowing eyes
a ridge of coarse black hair down the neck
a tattered sand-beige desert robe covering the body
empty clawed hands, loping crouch
must_not_show: living tan or brown human skin
burial shroud hanging off one shoulder

what: a huecuva: the corpse of a priest who broke his vows and died unforgiven, still in the rags of his vestments, painted seriously. He is a tall, gaunt, stooping walking corpse, long dead, and he is dead, never the colour of living skin: his skin is cold dark slate-grey with a blue-black tinge, the colour of a wet roof slate, dry, cracked with black cracks and shrunk tight on the bones, on the face, neck, hands and feet alike. He has a shrunken dead face: ears, a sharp thin nose, sunken cheeks, lips dried back from long teeth, and two round eyes filled to the brim with solid pale yellow light, with no pupils. His head is bald on top with a ragged ring of thin white hair round it, a monk's tonsure. His hands are bony with long cracked dirty claws. He has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall thin adult man: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold dark slate-grey dead skin with black cracks, a ring of thin white hair, sickly pale yellow glowing eyes, a rotted priest's robe of dirty grey-white linen, a long tattered stole of dull dark red cloth with frayed dull gold ends, a rope belt, a string of big dark wooden beads.
wears: He wears a priest's long robe of dirty grey-white linen reaching to his ankles, rotted and torn at the hem and sleeves, with a long narrow stole of dull dark red cloth hanging round his neck and down the front on both sides, a rope belt, and a string of big dark wooden beads at his waist. His head is bare, with no hood.
holds: His hands are empty. His right hand is raised high with two fingers lifted in a mocking blessing; his left hand is a claw reaching forward. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left, stooped and leaning in, his right hand raised high in a false blessing, his left clawed hand stretched out ahead to scratch, his head pushed forward with the mouth open, the red stole and torn robe swinging.
must_show: a gaunt corpse with cold dark slate-grey cracked dead skin and solid pale yellow glowing eyes
a monk's tonsure: bald crown with a ring of white hair
a rotted grey-white priest's robe with a long dark red stole
one hand raised in blessing, the other a reaching claw, both empty
no weapon

what: a jiangshi: the Chinese hopping corpse, a dead man stiff as a board, dressed as an official of the Qing court, painted seriously. It is a corpse and a monster, not a living man: the skin of its face and hands is pale grey-green like mould on stone, with black rings round blank white eyes that have no pupils, hollow cheeks, black lips, and an open mouth showing two short white fangs. Its hands have long, curved, black fingernails like claws. It stands rigid and upright, turned three-quarters toward the left, and both its arms are thrust stiffly out in front of its chest side by side, like a sleepwalker's, elbows locked, both hands side by side reaching toward the lower left corner of the picture. Stuck to the middle of its forehead and hanging down over its nose and mouth is one long rectangular strip of yellow paper with a few bold red brush strokes on it. It has the proportions of an adult man: a small head, about seven heads tall.
colours: pale grey-green dead skin like mould on stone, blank white eyes, a long black silk robe with one big square panel of dull gold and red embroidery on the chest, dull red cuffs, a round black official's hat with a red tassel on top, a yellow paper strip with red marks, black cloth boots with thick white soles.
wears: He wears the full dress of a Qing official: a long black silk robe to the ankles with wide dull red cuffs and one big square embroidered panel of dull gold and red on the chest, a round black hat with an upturned brim and a red tassel on its crown, a long string of big dark beads round his neck, and black cloth boots with thick white soles.
holds: His hands are empty; both arms are stretched straight out in front of his chest toward the left edge of the picture, and he holds nothing.
pose: Turned three-quarters to the left, it is caught in the middle of a hop: its whole body rigid and upright as a plank, both feet together and off the ground with the toes pointing down, both arms thrust out stiff in front of its chest side by side like a sleepwalker's, the two clawed hands close together at the left of the picture, the yellow paper strip hanging over its face, the hem of its robe lifting.
must_show: a stiff upright corpse with pale grey-green dead skin and blank white eyes
both arms thrust straight out in front of it side by side, the two hands close together
a yellow paper strip stuck on the forehead
a long black Qing official's robe with an embroidered chest square, and a round black hat with a red tassel
both feet together, hopping
empty hands
must_not_show: arms spread out to the left and right sides

what: a revenant: a wicked man of twelfth-century England, hanged and buried, who has climbed out of his grave to repay one wrong, and whom nothing will stop, painted seriously. He is a corpse, long dead, tall, big-boned and gaunt. He is dead, never the colour of living skin: his skin is cold slate-grey like a drowned man's, with darker grey-black shadows, on the face, neck, arms and hands alike. He has a shrunken dead face: ears, a broken nose, eyelids, lips dried back from clenched teeth, a heavy scowling brow, and two eyes filled to the brim with solid ember-orange light, with no pupils. Long, lank, grave-dirty black hair hangs to his shoulders. Round his neck is the hangman's noose he died in: a very thick, pale tan rope tied in a big knot under his ear, its long frayed end hanging down his chest to his belt. His forearms and big hands are bare and grey, caked with dark grave earth. He has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold slate-grey dead skin with grey-black shadows, lank black hair, ember-orange burning eyes, a very thick pale tan hangman's rope round the neck, a torn dark brown wool tunic caked with grey grave earth, ragged black hose, a frayed rope belt.
wears: He wears the clothes he was buried in: a knee-length dark brown wool tunic covering his whole body, torn and caked with grave earth, with the sleeves ripped away at the elbows so his grey forearms show, a rope belt, ragged black hose, and no shoes.
holds: His hands are empty: both big grey hands are stretched out ahead, open, with the fingers curled to close round a throat. He holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on two legs: he strides to the left in a long, heavy, unstoppable step with his weight on his front foot and his body leaning in, both arms stretched straight out in front of him toward the left edge of the picture at the height of a man's throat, the hands open to strangle, his head lowered and glaring, his hair and the frayed end of the noose swinging behind.
must_show: a tall gaunt corpse with cold slate-grey skin and burning ember-orange eyes
a very thick pale hangman's noose round his neck with its end hanging down
both empty arms stretched straight out ahead to strangle
a torn dark brown buried man's tunic covering the body
long lank black hair

what: a mummy: a classic walking Egyptian mummy, a thing made of bandages, painted seriously. From the top of its head to the soles of its feet it is completely wound in old linen bandages, layer over layer, like a figure built out of bandage, and nothing of the body underneath can be seen anywhere. Its head is a rounded bundle of bandages wound round and round, crossing over the top of the head, over the forehead, the nose, the cheeks, the mouth and the chin, so that the head has no face at all, only wrappings; in one dark gap between two bands, where the eyes would be, glow two small round lights of dull amber. Its chest, its arms, each hand like a bandaged mitten, its legs and its feet are wrapped the same way, the bands running slantwise and crossing, with dark lines between them. The linen is old, dry, frayed and stained. Four long loose ends of bandage trail from its arms and waist, joined to it. It is tall, thin, stiff and narrow-shouldered, with a small head and long limbs.
colours: old linen bandages on every part of it, dull grey-beige, the colour of old sacking, stained darker grey-brown, with dark brown lines between the bands, and two small dull amber glowing eyes in a dark gap. No other colour anywhere.
wears: It wears nothing but its bandages, which cover every part of it, the whole head and face included.
holds: Its hands are empty, wrapped in linen; it holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it lurches forward to the left, stiff-legged, dragging its back foot, both wrapped arms stretched out ahead with the hands open to seize, its head tilted and its jaw open, the loose bandage ends swinging behind it.
must_show: a tall thin figure completely wound in old grey-beige bandages from head to foot
the head a bundle of bandages with no face: no nose, no mouth, no ears, no bare scalp
two small dull amber glowing eyes in a dark gap in the head wrappings
loose bandage ends trailing, joined to the body
both wrapped arms reaching, lurching

what: a nosferatu: a vampire of the plague cellars with nothing courtly left in it, painted seriously. It is a tall, thin, hunched, narrow-shouldered figure, and it is dead, never the colour of living skin: its skin is cold chalk-white with blue-grey shadows, on the head, neck and hands alike. Its head is completely bald and long, with very large pointed ears like a bat's, a hooked nose, deep-sunk eyes with dark rings that glow a dull pale yellow, hollow cheeks, and a small open mouth from which two long thin rat's teeth stick down side by side at the very front, like a rat's incisors. Its hands are held up in front of its chest and its fingers are enormously long, thin and bony, ending in long curved grey nails. It has the realistic proportions of a tall thin adult man: a small head, a long thin neck, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold chalk-white dead skin with blue-grey shadows, dull pale yellow eyes, two white front teeth, grey nails, a long plain black coat buttoned to the throat with dull pewter buttons, black trousers, black shoes.
wears: It wears a long, narrow, plain black coat that reaches below its knees, buttoned tight from the throat to the waist with a row of dull pewter buttons, with a high stiff collar, narrow black trousers and black shoes. It has no cape.
holds: Its hands are empty: both are raised in front of its chest with the enormously long fingers spread and hooked. It holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it creeps forward to the left, hunched, shoulders drawn up to its ears and head pushed forward, both long-fingered hands raised in front of its chest and reaching, one foot stepping forward on tiptoe.
must_show: a completely bald head with very large pointed ears
two long rat's front teeth side by side
chalk-white dead skin
enormously long thin fingers raised and hooked
a long plain black coat buttoned to the throat, hunched thin body
the plainest and lowest of the three blood-drinkers
must_not_show: high cape collar round the head
two fangs at the corners of the mouth only

what: a vrykolakas: the restless dead of the Greek islands, a corpse that does not rot but swells up and goes knocking at doors by night, painted seriously. It is a corpse and a monster, not a living man. Its skin is dark lead-grey with blue-black shadows, the colour of a wet roof slate, shiny and stretched tight, nearly black at the lips, round the eyes and at the fingertips, on the face, neck, forearms, hands, shins and feet alike; no part of it is the colour of living skin. Its eyes are two bulging round balls of solid blank white with no pupils and no iris. It has a swollen dead face with puffed cheeks, a thick black moustache, short black hair, and a wide open mouth with black lips and two short thick white fangs. It was a heavy island villager, and it is hugely bloated: an enormous round paunch sticks far out in front of it, and its cream linen shirt is stretched tight over the whole of that paunch like a sail full of wind, buttons straining, tucked into its sash.
colours: dark lead-grey dead skin with a faint dull plum tinge, blank white eyes, a thick black moustache and short black hair, white fangs, a dirty cream linen shirt stained with grey grave earth, a short black wool waistcoat, a broad dull dark red sash, baggy black knee-breeches, bare lead-grey lower legs and feet.
wears: He wears a Greek islander's burial clothes, strained by his swollen body: a dirty cream linen shirt with wide sleeves pushed up to the elbows, covering his whole chest and belly, a short black wool waistcoat that no longer meets across his belly, a broad dull dark red sash, and baggy black knee-breeches. His feet are bare.
holds: His hands are empty. His right hand is a raised clenched fist, knuckles forward, in the act of knocking on a door; his left hand hangs open and swollen at his side. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, he stands planted wide and leans forward to the left, his enormous shirt-covered paunch pushed out ahead of him, his right fist raised to head height and rapping forward with the knuckles as if on a door, his head lowered and glaring with blank white eyes, his mouth wide open calling out a name, fangs showing.
must_show: a grossly bloated corpse with an enormous round paunch under a tight cream shirt
dark lead-grey dead skin with a faint plum tinge, and blank white bulging eyes
a black moustache and short fangs
a Greek islander's cream shirt covering the belly, black waistcoat, red sash, baggy black breeches
one fist raised knocking, both hands empty

what: a strigoi: the troubled dead of Romanian villages, named from the screech owl that drank blood by night, a dead man who climbs from his grave and goes home to feed on his own family, painted seriously. He is a tall, lean, strong, long-limbed walking corpse. He is dead, never the colour of living skin: his skin is cold lead-grey with blue-black shadows, the colour of a wet gravestone, drawn tight over the bones, on the face, neck, forearms and hands alike. He has a gaunt dead face with ears, a sharp hooked nose, hollow cheeks, and lips dried back from a mouth stretched wide open in a screech, showing two long white fangs. His eyes are an owl's: very large, perfectly round, glowing bright yellow, each with one small black pupil, set under heavy brows. He has a wild, long, tangled mane of rust-red hair and a ragged rust-red beard, clotted with dark grave earth. His bare forearms are sinewy and end in big hands with long hooked black talons like an owl's. He has the realistic proportions of a tall adult man: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold lead-grey dead skin with blue-black shadows, wild rust-red hair and beard, large round bright yellow owl's eyes, white fangs, black talons, a long sleeveless coat of black shaggy sheepskin, a dirty cream linen peasant's shirt with a band of dull red stitching at the neck, a broad brown leather belt, dark grey wool trousers, dark grave earth.
wears: He wears a Romanian peasant's burial clothes: a dirty cream linen shirt that covers his chest and belly, with a band of dull red stitching at the neck and the sleeves torn off at the elbows, a long sleeveless coat of black shaggy sheepskin hanging open over it to his knees, a broad brown leather belt, and dark grey wool trousers. His head is bare and his feet are bare.
holds: His hands are empty: two big taloned hands. He holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, he swoops forward to the left in a long lunging stride like a bird stooping on prey, body pitched forward, both arms raised and spread wide above his shoulders with the black talons hooked downward, his head thrust forward with the round yellow eyes staring and the fanged mouth wide open screeching, his red hair and the black sheepskin coat flying back.
must_show: a lean corpse with cold lead-grey dead skin
very large round glowing yellow owl's eyes
wild rust-red hair and beard
a black shaggy sheepskin coat over a cream peasant's shirt covering the chest
raised empty hands with black talons, mouth open with fangs
the strongest and most fearsome of the three blood-drinkers

what: a gravehound: the skeleton of a king's hunting dog, buried with him long ago and woken by tomb robbers, painted seriously. It is the bare skeleton of a real dog, with a dog's long narrow skull, on four legs, seen from the side, with no fur and no flesh on it anywhere: a long narrow dog's skull with empty jaws full of long white teeth, a row of neck bones, a deep cage of big curved ribs with dark empty gaps between them through which the backdrop can be seen, a knobbly spine, hip bones, four long thin leg bones with the joints showing, and a long thin tail of small bones. It is the skeleton of a lean, long-legged sighthound. All the bone is dull grey-brown, dug from a grave, never white and never gold. A few stiff tatters of dry, shrunken, dark brown hide still cling to it like old leather: one across the top of the skull with two ragged scraps for ears, one over the shoulders, one hanging from the ribs, one on the haunch. In each eye socket of the skull burns one small cold pale-white point of light. Round its neck bones, just behind the skull, sits a very broad, heavy collar of tarnished gold, as wide as the skull is deep, like a king's arm-ring, plain to see.
colours: dull grey-brown grave-stained bone with dark brown shadows, a few tatters of dark brown dried hide, long white teeth, two small pale white eye lights, a broad collar of tarnished brown-gold, the colour of old brass.
wears: It wears only the broad tarnished gold collar of a king's hound.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: the skeleton hound runs at full stretch in a hunting gallop, front leg bones reaching far forward and hind leg bones driving out behind, skull low and level with the jaws wide open to bite, the bony tail streaming straight back.
must_show: the bare skeleton of a lean hound on four legs, seen from the side, running
ribs with dark gaps between them, spine and leg bones plain to see
a dog's skull with bared teeth and two small pale eye lights
tatters of dark dried hide clinging to the bones
a broad tarnished gold collar

what: a mohrg: the skeleton of a murderer who died unpunished, with one terrible living thing left inside it, painted seriously. It is a tall human skeleton with no muscle anywhere: a small skull with a hanging jaw, a long neck and spine, long thin arm bones and leg bones, all dull grey-brown, dug from a grave, never gold and never white. Its ribcage is broken open at the front, the ribs bent outward to left and right like the bars of a burst cage. Inside the open ribcage, filling it, is a thick coiled mass like a heap of fat snakes, dark purple and glistening: this is its tongue, coiled where the heart should be. From the coils the tongue rises up through the neck, out between the jaws of the skull, and lashes far out in front of it: one enormously long, thick tongue, as thick as its arm, dark purple with a paler lilac underside, curling like a whip and ending in a pointed tip. It stands about eight heads tall.

what: a nightwing: the greatest of the nightshades, a vast bat-shaped shadow that blots out the stars, an engine of death, painted seriously with depth and light. It is one enormous flying shape of living darkness in the form of a giant bat, seen from the front, drawn small enough that the whole of it, both wing tips included, fits well inside the picture with a wide margin of empty backdrop on the left, on the right, above and below. Its two wings are raised and curved, their tips pointing up. The wings are ragged sheets of soot-black darkness, torn into long tatters along their lower edges, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges. Along the top of each wing runs a thick arm bone, and from it four long thick finger bones fan down through the wing like the ribs of an umbrella: all these bones are pale bone-white and plain to see against the black. Between the wings is a small, narrow, dark body with a short wedge-shaped head that has two tall pointed ears, two narrow slanted eyes of burning white light with no pupils, and an open mouth of long pale fangs. One thin bright line of amber light runs along the upper edge of each wing. Its body ends below in a ragged point of darkness.

what: a wendigo: the starving winter giant of Algonquian tales, with a heart of ice and a hunger that is never filled, painted seriously as a terrible lord of the dead. It is an enormously tall, gaunt, stooped, long-limbed giant, starved to skin and bone, with no muscle on it: every rib shows, its belly is a deep hollow under the ribcage, its shoulders, elbows and knees are sharp knobs, and its arms hang past its knees. It is dead, never the colour of living skin: its skin is cold ash-grey like a body frozen in the snow, cracked and rimed with white frost, on the head, body and limbs alike. Its head is gaunt and long with a shrunken dead face: sunken cheeks, a thin nose, tattered lips drawn back from long jagged teeth, and two deep-set eyes that glow pale icy blue with no pupils, with long, thin, lank white hair hanging beside the face. From its skull grow two great branching stag's antlers of dark grey-brown, hung with frost and icicles. In the middle of its chest, between the ribs, a jagged lump of ice glows pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky: its frozen heart. Its hands are huge, with very long fingers ending in long claws of clear pale ice.
